skill_name: Compare and contrast "Romantic Poetry" and "Victorian Poetry".
workflow: Romantic Poetry and Victorian Poetry are two types of poetry that are linked but have distinct differences. Romantic Poetry, written during the late 18th and early 19th centuries, focused on individual emotions, imaginative exploration, and a tone of spontaneity and freedom. Its emphasis placed on nature and the internal world of the individual, rather than societal constraints and outside pressures.
